title: TrackerPhoneReplicaService
responsibility: Build bounded, scoped iPhone Tracker replica pages and carry planning data with the visible items.

inputs.name: TrackerPhoneReplicaService.constructor.store
inputs.description: The native hub’s authoritative SQLite journal.

inputs.name: TrackerPhoneReplicaService.constructor.now
inputs.description: Returns wall-clock milliseconds for retention and response timestamps.

inputs.name: TrackerPhoneReplicaService.constructor.grant
inputs.description: Optional write grant for the exact device. Omitting it leaves the hub projection readable without a writer.

inputs.name: TrackerPhoneReplicaService.pull.query
inputs.description: A validated paired scope and optional delta cursor or snapshot continuation.

inputs.name: PhoneReplicaFeed.constructor.store
inputs.description: The hub journal that owns the source and derived feed tables.

inputs.name: PhoneReplicaFeed.refresh.now
inputs.description: Wall-clock milliseconds used to set feed operation age and select recent items.

inputs.name: PhoneReplicaFeed.after.sequence
inputs.description: The decimal SQLite sequence from the previous consumed operation.

inputs.name: snapshotPage.snapshot
inputs.description: The projected rows and high-water cursor frozen for one snapshot.

inputs.name: snapshotPage.offset
inputs.description: The first row the device has yet to consume.

inputs.name: deltaPage.rows
inputs.description: Candidate operation rows ordered by increasing hub sequence.

inputs.name: deltaPage.input
inputs.type: { cursor: string; sequence: string; now: number }
inputs.description: The requested cursor, its sequence and the hub clock.

inputs.name: phoneReplicaRows.db
inputs.description: The native SQLite handle for a consistent view of item and run data.

inputs.name: phoneReplicaRows.node
inputs.description: The origin label for locally recorded runs.

inputs.name: phoneReplicaRows.now
inputs.description: Wall-clock milliseconds used to select closed items in retention.

inputs.name: readPhoneReplicaItem.db
inputs.description: The authoritative hub SQLite journal.

inputs.name: readPhoneReplicaItem.id
inputs.description: The exact item ID to find within the current phone retention set.

inputs.name: readPhoneReplicaItem.now
inputs.description: Wall clock in milliseconds used to apply the same closed-item retention period as the feed.

inputs.name: attentionRevision.item
inputs.description: The selected item row with its attention clocks, flag state and question.

errors.name: invalidRequest
errors.description: The scope or position fields do not match the read request contract.

errors.name: projectionStorage
errors.description: The Tracker database could not read or commit a projection. The caller returns a generic hub failure.

errors.name: invalidProjection
errors.description: The stored projection row cannot be decoded as JSON.
